commands.author: qingminglong

target.title: fix(memory): qmd search fails when logs prefix results
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where qmd-backed memory search could report invalid JSON when qmd writes malformed or bracketed noise before the actual result array.

## Why This Change Was Made

The noisy stdout parser now scans complete top-level qmd result arrays in one pass, skips malformed qmd-like prefixes and bracketed log fragments, and preserves nested JSON inside valid qmd results. The change stays inside the memory-host qmd parser and adds focused parser and memory-core manager coverage for the noisy stdout path.

## User Impact

Memory search can tolerate common qmd/native stdout prefixes and still return matching results instead of failing the lookup. Malformed log fragments before the result array no longer prevent the later valid qmd result array from being parsed.

## Evidence

- Claim proved at `ff6b133375368c9538d53f8b4fda7b9fb50509be`: qmd stdout parsing now recovers a later valid result array after malformed qmd-like prefixes such as `[{oops` or an incomplete quoted array fragment, while still refusing complete unknown nested arrays as the result payload.
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/qmd-manager.test.ts -- -t "bracketed stdout log prefixes|unmatched bracket fragments|quoted malformed log fragments|nested unknown array fields|nested array fields before the outer result array"` passed with 2 Vitest shards; selected coverage was 4 parser regression cases and 1 memory-core manager case.
- Runtime parser proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` imported `packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.ts`, parsed stdout beginning with `[{oops` and `[INFO] warmup`, and returned `[{"score":0.93,"snippet":"@@ -2,1\nrouter glacier backup","startLine":2,"endLine":2}]` from the later valid result array.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check -- packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.ts packages/memory-host-sdk/src/host/qmd-query-parser.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/memory/qmd-manager.test.ts` passed.
